world_model_patterns.description: Improperly decommissioned cloud resources create persistent security vulnerabilities that attackers actively target

mitigation_strategies: Quarterly resource audits with automated detection
Cloud Asset Inventory for continuous tracking
Resource tagging with creation date, owner, purpose

Deprecated service accounts with IAM permissions
Old secret versions in Secret Manager
